_comment: Maps a FIDE profile ID (the Chief Organizer's ratings.fide.com/profile/<id> id, as shown on a tournament's tournament_information.phtml page) to a club/organizer website. Prefer a tournaments/events page over a homepage when the club has one — it's what a player actually wants. Hand-curated — extend as new frequent organizers show up in the scraped feed. A few entries below are inferred from city/venue overlap rather than an explicit organizer-club statement (noted per entry); drop them if they turn out wrong.

2059487._note: Grant Oen is CCC's Senior Events Manager
